context.transcript:
Okay, Ms. Torres, I have your price estimate.
To have the whole exterior of your house painted, including the fence, will cost you $5,000.
That's quite a bit more than we expected.
And actually, Colgate Painting said they would do it for $4,000.
Well, the cost of paint and supplies is included in the price I quoted you, so we really offer a very good deal.
That's a bit of a relief.
If there are no other charges, we'll probably be able to stay within our budget.
Thank you.
Thank you.
Thank you.
context.transcript_translation:
好的，Torres 女士，这是您的价格估算。
要将您房屋的整个外部包括围栏都涂成油漆，费用是 5,000 美元。
这比我们预期的要多很多。
实际上，Colgate Painting 说他们可以做成 4,000 美元。
嗯，我给您的价格里包含了油漆和材料的成本，所以我们提供的真的是一个非常好的交易。
这让人稍微放心了。
如果没有任何其他费用，我们可能就能控制在预算之内了。
谢谢您。
谢谢您。
谢谢您。
